title: Probe finding record, version 1
description: The unit a discovery loop hands to the refutation stage. This file is the SINGLE source of truth for structure and enums: tools/probe/refute.py loads it and drives its structural checks from it rather than restating the field list, because two copies of one fact drift (see tools/score_frontend_capture.py on derived ceilings). Cardinality rules that carry a diagnosis - 'you stated no rival', 'you ran no prediction' - are deliberately NOT expressed as minItems here; they belong to named admissibility rules in refute.py so the report says which rule fired instead of a generic schema error.

id.description: Stable slug. Appears in the refutation ledger; do not reuse across different claims.

sourceNote.description: Path of the write-up this record was distilled from, if any.

findingKind.description: instrument-derived means a probe, proxy, tracer or harness WE built produced the evidence. Those owe a control arm that demonstrates the instrument can produce a negative result at all.

statement.description: ONE assertion. If it needs an 'and', it is two findings.

grade.description: EXECUTED - observed while the engine ran. MEASURED_STATIC - read from specimen bytes. CORPUS - counted over shipped data. DERIVED - computed from a measurement by a stated rule. INFERRED - reasoned from a measurement that does not compel it. ASSERTED - none of the above. Ordered strongest first; the claim may not be graded above the weakest evidence in its discriminating chain.

mechanism.description: Dotted subsystem tags the claim is ABOUT, e.g. 'shader.final_combine', 'exporter.quantizer'. These are matched against residual and discriminator tags, so spell them consistently; tools/probe/refute.py --mechanisms lists the ones already in use.

population.description: What the claim ranges over: 'all shipped skinned vertices', 'every level archive'.

covered.description: How much of that population the evidence actually touched.

notCovered.description: Named exclusions. An empty list on a claim over a population is itself the smell: it says the author did not look for one.

rivals.description: Competing explanations that the SAME evidence would also produce. This is the field the 2026-07-31 skin-weight failure did not have.

strawman.description: Set true only when deliberately recording a rival that is not live. A record whose every rival is a strawman is inadmissible.

indistinguishableOn.description: The observations that are TRUE under both. Listing these is how you notice that your evidence, while real, does not choose.

outcome.description: Which side the observation landed on. 'none' is only valid when status is not 'observed'.

predictions.description: Tests that WERE run, whose results were written down BEFORE running them. Tests not yet run belong in overturnedBy, not here.

procedure.description: Reproducible enough that someone else runs the same thing.

wouldFalsifyIf.description: The concrete outcome that kills the claim. If you cannot name one that the procedure could actually have produced, the test is decoration.

statedAt.description: When/where the prediction was written down - commit, note path, timestamp.

instrument.description: What did the observing: a script path, a proxy build, a debugger, 'read by hand'.

independentReplicates.description: Separate sessions, runs or specimens. One run repeated 60 times is n=60, replicates=1.

specimen.description: Required whenever the grade is byte-derived and a specimen path is named: this project's standing rule is that byte findings name the specimen file and its hash.

residuals.description: Everything still unresolved. blocksClaim is the load-bearing field: a residual whose mechanism is also a discriminator's mechanism CANNOT honestly be marked non-blocking, and that combination is exactly the 2026-07-31 failure.

poisonControl.description: An arm that SHOULD produce a negative outcome. Without one, a clean result cannot be told apart from an instrument that reports clean no matter what.

result.description: 'failed_as_predicted' means the control produced the negative outcome it was built to produce, so the instrument is demonstrably capable of a negative.

overturnedBy.description: Tests NOT yet run that would kill the claim. Never empty: a claim no future observation could overturn is not a finding.
